registration.title: Paper rule: minimum edge raised from 3% to 10%, Bet365 prices only, more goal lines
registration.what: The paper simulation takes a selection only when the model's chance times the price is at least 1.10 (it was 1.03), takes Bet365's price and no other bookmaker's, and bets on over/under 1.5, 3.5 and 4.5 as well as 2.5.
registration.why: At 3% the rule placed about fifty bets on a Saturday. Bet365 is the bookmaker actually bet with. The goal markets were the closest to the bookmakers in the first model-against-market check.
registration.how: One threshold and one bookmaker id in the betting rule, and three more goal lines calibrated on 2023/24.
registration.hypothesis: Not specified: no hypothesis about returns was recorded.

events.reason: The owner's choice of rule; no evaluation was run before it.
